Information for the 2025-2026 School Year

Important Dates:

To be considered for the lottery applications must be received by April 30. See application instruction below.

Lottery will take place and notifications will be sent the week of May 5-9.

Dual Language Immersion (DLI) at Hawks View Elementary

The Sherwood School District is excited to continue our Spanish/English Dual Language Immersion Program for the 2025-26 school year.  We are in our sixth year of the program, and have classes in Kindergarten – Fifth grade.  A Dual Language Immersion Program has the goal of promoting bilingualism, bi-literacy, and socio-cultural competence. 

Applications for each year’s new Kindergarten class as well as any other grade openings are accepted each spring. If you applied last year, you will remain on the waiting list and do not need to re-apply.

Steps to apply for the Dual Language Immersion Program

  1. Enroll the student in the Sherwood School District-see our Enrollment Process Page.
  2. Fill out the DLI Application-2025/2026 application
  3. If accepted, sign and return the participation agreement.

If we have more applicants than spots a lottery will be held in May and applicants will be notified of the results.

For more information, please see link for flyer below.

Contacts

Kellie Johnson-Hawks View Main Office kmjohnson@sherwood.k12.or.us

Amy Mitchell-Principal of Hawks View Elementary ammitchell@sherwood.k12.or.us

Maria Lira-Wiser-Hawks View Multilingual Specialist mlirawiser@sherwood.k12.or.us

Ursula Pinto-Community Liaison/Enlace Comunitario upinto@sherwood.k12.or.us
